product_from_film: Claude on mobile drafts an email and carries the same meeting into a calendar event form.
explains_well: One meeting stays consistent across the request, email draft, email composer and calendar form.
unclear: The assistant says it has added the meeting before the native calendar Add step, which can blur draft preparation and completion.
scenario: Prepare an urgent meeting email and create its calendar event.
product_clear_basis: The request produces a visible email card with the matching meeting subject.
